title: Perfect
text: Perfect. I've been searching for weeks for the perfect pillow. I don't like a high loft and I like a soft, but medium firm pillow & this was it. I really like that it's made in the USA & it comes with extra stuffing for later

product_metadata.title: Snuggle-Pedic Shredded Memory Foam Pillow - The Original Cool Pillows for Side, Stomach & Back Sleepers - Sleep Support That Keeps Shape - College Dorm Room Essentials for Girls and Guys - King
features: QUALITY - Rest easy knowing that our memory foam pillows are put under stringent third party lab testing and are GreenGuard Gold Certified to ensure your safety, quality and comfort.

LUXURY - This luxurious bamboo pillow is what dreams are made of! The proprietary mix of shredded memory foam provides added buoyant support and is designed with you (and your sleep schedule) in mind.
COMFORT - Just when you thought this cooling pillow couldn't be cooler. The breathability and Kool-Flow technology of our side sleeper pillows make sweating while you sleep a thing of the past.
SUPPORT - Ready, set, sleep! Whether you're a back, stomach, or side sleeper, you'll find top-tier support with our zipper-free, self-adapting bed pillows.
MADE IN THE USA - Our queen pillows are super durable, built for everyone, and best of all, Made in the USA which ensures the best quality pillow!
